p: He that dasheth in pieces is: That is, Nebuchadnezzar is in readiness to destroy the Assyrians: and the Prophet derides the undertakings of the Assyrians who prepared to resist him.
turned away the excellency of Jacob: Seeing God has punished his own people Judah and Israel, he will now punish the enemies by whom he scourged them; read Isa 10:12.
marred their vine branches: Signifying that the Israelites were utterly destroyed.
the valiant men are in scarlet: Both to put fear into the enemy, and also that they themselves should not so soon detect blood among one another, to discourage them.
the fir trees shall be terribly: Meaning their spears would shake and crash together.
He shall recount his worthies: Then the Assyrians will seek by all means to gather their power, but all things will fail them.

old like a pool of water: The Assyrians will flatter themselves and say that Nineveh is so ancient that it can never perish, and is as a fishpool, whose waters cannot be touched by those that walk on the banks. But they will be scattered, and will not look back, even if men call them.
Take ye the spoil of silver: God commands the enemies to spoil Nineveh, and promises them infinite riches and treasures.
She is empty: That is, Nineveh, and the men of it will be after this manner.
of them all gather blackness: Read Geneva "Joe 2:6"
dwelling of the lions: Meaning, Nineveh, whose inhabitants were cruel like the lions, and given to all oppression, and spared no violence or tyranny to provide for their wives and children.
smoke: That is, as soon as my wrath begins to burn.
messengers shall no more be heard: Signifying the heralds, who were accustomed to proclaim war. Some read, "of you gum teeth", with which Nineveh was accustomed to bruise the bones of the poor.
